hooks.name: Privacy review of expansion and storage code
hooks.description: Enforces the product privacy rules whenever code that touches the network, storage or the camera changes.

action.prompt: Code that touches the network, storage or the camera was just saved. Check the changed file against the privacy rules in .kiro/steering/product.md: no logging of typed text, context or model output (the route logs status and latency only); no server-side storage; only typed text and the last 10 turns are sent to /api/expand; camera frames, landmarks and blendshape scores never leave the device or reach storage; the LLM key is read server-side only and never appears in a response, header, log or error; no analytics or third-party requests (MediaPipe assets are self-hosted). Fix any violation now, or reply with one line saying the file passes.
